principle: BGM is a selectable poem-level presentation asset. Narration remains the foreground and is never attenuated by the BGM mixer.
selection_priority: stable pseudo-random local BGM by poem_id
note: Every selected BGM is first loudness-normalized to the same low background target, then an optional per-poem gain_db trim is applied. Unmapped poems automatically receive a reproducible pseudo-random track from bgm/, keyed by poem_id, so re-rendering the same poem keeps the same BGM unless the local track set changes.
